5f6032b8b38f6cc7.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is seeking an Engineering Manager to support the overall maintenance and engineering operations of its new resort in The Red Sea, located between Umluj and Al Wajh. This full-time role requires strong technical expertise and people management skills to ensure efficient, safe, and standard-compliant system operations within a luxury environment. The Engineering Manager will work closely with the Assistant Director of Engineering to achieve guest satisfaction and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Supervise engineering team members on a daily basis. Execute preventive maintenance programs across the resort. Resolve technical issues promptly and effectively. Ensure all resort systems function efficiently, safely, and in line with Four Seasons standards. Respond to operational needs in a fast-paced environment. Qualifications and Experience Degree or vocational certificate in Electromechanical or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in hotel engineering or maintenance, with supervisory or managerial exposure. Solid electromechanical background; experience in powerhouse operations is an advantage. Exposure to ESG initiatives and sustainability practices. Proficiency in reading technical reports, understanding maintenance budgets, and using CMMS systems. Fluent in English, both spoken and written. Required Skills Strong leadership and organizational skills. Effective interpersonal skills. Strong communication and problem-solving abilities. Ability to analyze utility consumption trends and support energy conservation initiatives. The company values mutual respect and aims to create lasting impressions for guests, residents, and partners worldwide. This commitment extends to fostering a world-class employee experience. The Red Sea Destination The Red Sea destination, located along 200 km of coastline between Umluj and Al Wajh in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, is being developed as a luxury beachside destination. 5f273aa8cade31f8.description: About Doumind Doumind assists organizations in leveraging data and AI solutions, digital transformation strategies, and enterprise platforms such such as CRM. The company also provides agent automation, IT service and asset management (ITSM & ITAM), and workflow automation to enhance operational efficiency. Doumind supports clients in establishing robust data governance and data management capabilities to ensure reliable and scalable insights. The mission is to enable organizations to become data-driven, efficient, and prepared for the future, serving as a partner for digital transformation in the Kingdom. The Account Manager Role Doumind is seeking an Account Manager with 3–5 years of experience to manage and expand a portfolio of client accounts across both public and private sectors. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Account Manager will serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building trusted relationships, understanding their transformation priorities, and collaborating with Doumind's consulting, solution, and delivery teams to translate these priorities into successful engagements. This role is accountable for client satisfaction, retention, renewals, and account growth across Doumind's offerings in data, AI, automation, and enterprise platforms. Key Responsibilities Client Relationship Management: Manage an assigned portfolio of client accounts, serving as the primary point of contact. Build relationships from operational teams to senior leaders such as CIOs, CDOs, and digital transformation heads. Develop a clear understanding of each client's business goals, data maturity, and transformation roadmap. Lead regular account and business reviews to share progress, gather feedback, and agree on next steps. Solution Coordination and Delivery Oversight: Collaborate with Doumind's solution architects, consultants, and delivery teams to shape solutions across data and AI, data governance, CRM, agent automation, ITSM & ITAM, and workflow automation. Monitor project progress, milestones, and outcomes, ensuring delivery meets agreed scope and client expectations. Identify risks or issues early and coordinate their resolution with internal teams. Commercial Ownership and Growth: Prepare proposals, presentations, and statements of work, and support RFP and tender responses with the presales team. Own contract, license, and support renewals, negotiating commercial terms in line with company guidelines. Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities and develop account plans to grow revenue in each account. Contribute to pipeline development and meet or exceed retention, renewal, and revenue targets. Account Administration and Reporting: Maintain accurate and up-to-date account records, opportunities, and forecasts in the CRM. Track account health and performance metrics, reporting them to management. Share client feedback and market insights with internal teams to help improve Doumind's offerings. Qualifications and Experience 3–5 years of experience in account management. Experience managing accounts with Saudi government, semi-government, or large enterprise clients. Familiarity with public sector procurement processes (*, Etimad). Exposure to Vision 2030 digital transformation programs. Familiarity with Saudi data regulations and frameworks, such as the NDMO data management standards and the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Relevant certifications, such as ITIL Foundation, a CRM platform certification, or a recognized sales or account management methodology. Work Type and Location This is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

5fae7a7fbf11c8fa.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع نعمة الخير للمعجنات والشكولاته عن مدير فرع للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على عمليات الفرع وتطويرها بما يتماشى مع الأهداف الاستراتيجية للشركة، مع ضمان توفير الموارد اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة وإعداد أهداف الفرع بما يتوافق مع التوجهات والاستراتيجيات العامة للجهة. إدارة وتخطيط وتنظيم أعمال الفرع ووحداته الإدارية وفقاً للخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية المعتمدة. متابعة كافة العمليات الإدارية المتعلقة بالفرع، وضمان توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية. تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية للفرع ومتابعة تنفيذها لتحقيق أفضل المخرجات وأعلى مستويات الكفاءة والإنتاجية. الإشراف العام على سير العمليات والإجراءات في الفرع، وضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المعتمدة. الإشراف على أداء موظفي الفرع، ومتابعة برامج الموارد البشرية لتقييم أدائهم وتطويرهم وتحفيزهم. بناء علاقات عمل مع الشركاء الخارجيين وتنسيق المشروعات والجهود المشتركة، وضمان قنوات تواصل داخلية فعالة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة الفروع أو العمليات. القدرة على وضع الخطط والأهداف ومتابعة تحقيقها. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية لإدارة فرق العمل وتطويرها. فهم جيد للأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات الإدارية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لبناء العلاقات الداخلية والخارجية. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير الفرع بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في مصنع نعمة الخير للمعجنات والشكولاته بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع فرق العمل الداخلية والشركاء الخارجيين لضمان تحقيق أهداف الفرع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

5f6558a19c42dc6e.description: About the Role Tas'Helat Marketing is seeking a Project Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves managing multiple projects from initiation to close-out, with a focus on fuel station systems and infrastructure. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Finalize project timescales, costs, and resources with consultants and contractors, and prepare the overall project delivery plan and baseline schedule using Primavera P6 / MS Project for review. Develop detailed scopes of work for consultancy and contractor packages, support tendering and technical bid evaluation, and submit for approval. Manage design development with internal stakeholders and design consultants, covering civil works, canopy, forecourt, underground fuel storage tanks, piping, dispensers, electrical, fire-fighting, and building works. Supervise site execution to ensure contract delivery within approved budget and timeframes. Monitor project budgets, verify contractor progress payments, evaluate variations and claims, and maintain cost control. Track progress against the baseline schedule, identify delays, drive recovery plans, and resolve site issues. Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are met across all sites, including permit-to-work, hot work, and excavation controls, particularly at operating stations. Maintain the project risk register and manage change requests. Ensure works meet approved drawings, specifications, and standards (*, NFPA 30/30A, SASO, Saudi Building Code); review ITPs and attend inspections and tests. Coordinate with municipality, Civil Defense, Ministry of Energy, and utility companies (SEC, NWC) for permits, approvals, and connections. Lead a multi-disciplinary internal and external team and act as the main point of contact for consultants, contractors, suppliers, and station operations. Prepare regular progress reports covering schedule, cost, HSE, quality, and issues, and attend project progress meetings. Oversee testing and commissioning activities, close out snag lists, and hand over as-built drawings and O&M manuals. Complete contractual and financial close-out and record lessons learned. Qualifications and Requirements Proven record of managing multiple projects simultaneously from initiation to close-out, including planning, cost control, contract, and subcontractor management. Strong knowledge of fuel station systems, including underground storage tanks, fuel piping, dispensers, vapor recovery, ATG, and fire-fighting systems. Good knowledge of applicable codes, standards, and HSE regulations (NFPA 30/30A, SASO, Saudi Building Code, Civil Defense requirements). Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to travel between project sites. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, requiring travel between project sites as needed. The role involves leading and coordinating with multi-disciplinary internal and external teams.

5fee7e7af8199708.description: We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Maintenance Manager to oversee maintenance, facilities, and technical operations across a large hospitality, F&B, and entertainment venue. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing a multidisciplinary maintenance team, including lighting operators, gardeners, plumbers, painters, and general maintenance personnel. The role requires strong leadership, technical knowledge, and organisational skills to ensure that all facilities, outdoor areas, landscaping, lighting installations, and infrastructure are maintained to a high standard and remain fully operational. Ensure all structures, fixtures, fittings, and equipment are maintained to a high standard. Develop and implement preventative maintenance schedules. Coordinate reactive maintenance and ensure issues are resolved promptly. Conduct regular site inspections to identify maintenance requirements and potential safety concerns. 2. Good technical knowledge of lighting systems, plumbing, landscaping, painting, and general building maintenance. Experience developing preventative maintenance plans and managing daily maintenance schedules. Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple maintenance requirements in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and contractor management skills. Good understanding of health and safety procedures. 5fb4e2527b4aeac8.description: About the Role Bilfinger is seeking an experienced Lead HSE Officer to manage and drive Health, Safety, and Environmental initiatives within refinery and petrochemical maintenance operations in Dammam. This full-time role focuses on ensuring compliance with HSE regulations, implementing robust HSE management systems, and fostering a strong safety culture across projects. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for leading HSE efforts, conducting audits and investigations, and promoting best practices to maintain a safe and environmentally compliant work environment. This position requires a proactive approach to safety management and a commitment to continuous improvement in HSE performance. Key Responsibilities Lead and maintain the HSE Management System in compliance with ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and relevant industry standards. Conduct HSE audits, inspections, and compliance assessments to identify areas for improvement. Manage and coordinate HSE personnel and audit schedules effectively. Investigate accidents, incidents, and near-misses, performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence. Monitor Permit to Work (PTW) activities and ensure the safe execution of all work. Facilitate Job Safety Analysis (JSA) and risk assessments for critical activities. Conduct site safety inspections and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
